name: Cubtek Inc.
summary: Cubtek Inc. engages in the complete cycle of research, development, design, manufacturing, and commercialization of advanced automotive safety systems and components. The company extends its operations across Taiwan, mainland China, and other international markets. Its core offerings include sophisticated advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) and specialized millimeter-wave radar sensors developed for these vehicular ADAS applications. Additionally, Cubtek produces and supplies associated parts. Established in 2016, the company is headquartered in Zhubei, Taiwan.
